description.value:
A capacity attachment: it adds rounds to the weapon's base capacity, by weapon type: Pistol (all) +76, SMG (all) +80, Crossbow +39, Shotgun +48, Assault Rifle +100, Machine Gun +160, Sniper Rifle +32, Grenade Launcher +16, Rocket Launcher +8.

One capacity attachment per weapon. Crossbows can take one too; a loaded crossbow magazine holds one arrow type (you can still hand-load another with a free hand).

Item Compendium (2070) • Attachments & Mods
